about.title: A bit about me
paragraphs: Frontend engineer with 3+ years of commercial experience. Before that I built outsourced projects for different clients, and now I work on a fleet telematics product.
I work together with backend, design and DevOps: we align API contracts, take features to release and investigate production issues.
My main stack is Vue 3 and TypeScript; I also work with React and Next.js.

highlights: Own the product frontend: architecture, features and production releases.
SPA redesign: new UI and UX, updated module structure while keeping the core architecture.
Build real-time monitoring interfaces with REST APIs and WebSockets.
Develop interactive maps with OpenLayers and deck.gl for large GPS point sets.
Built geofencing tools: creating and editing zones on the map.
Align API contracts with the backend team.
Run code reviews and onboarding, and maintain internal frontend documentation.
Moved business logic into a tested domain layer with build-enforced boundaries.
Fixed GPU memory and map performance issues in long sessions.
Maintain CI/CD across development, staging and production.
Outsourced development for iGaming and crypto clients: landing pages, SPAs and CRM systems.
